policies.partial: Retain at most 2.5 dB measured natural growth
policies.natural_limited: Retain natural growth until 4.5 dB cap; cap applied smoothly as linked control gain, no limiter

near_field.perceptual_status: Timbre, localization, externalization, closeness and comfort PENDING HUMAN
near_field.input_loop: Same 2s own-stem probe, 20ms boundary fades, twelve repeats in a 24s diagnostic montage
near_field.limitation: Static RMS calibration controls gain, not perceptual loudness. Nominal .25m display rounds to tenths.
near_field.distance_cue_analysis: Static level-matched waveform residual and band deltas quantify changes remaining after best linked scalar fit. Small residuals indicate gain-dominated control, not verified physical near-field cues.

source.dual_mono: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no interchannel cancellation, other-channel-exclusive content omitted

limitations: Identical synchronous sources are correlated and can fuse into one phantom image. This requested diagnostic cannot establish independent-object capacity for uncorrelated musical sources.
Count gain uses 1/sqrt(N), not guaranteed identical loudness for coherent sums. Listen for two positions rather than volume changes.
objects.criterion: Where does separation disappear: isolated, pairs or four? No instrument identification.

masking.method: 4096-point Hann STFT, 2048 hop; stereo summed power, RMS after existing role gain
masking.policy: Only non-anchor support with band overlap >.75 and relative RMS >-8dB receives modest linked attenuation, 250ms ramps. No global or corrective EQ.
masking.limitation: Band overlap and coactivity indicate potential competition, not a measured psychoacoustic masking threshold. Musical usefulness requires listening.
masking.temporal_method: 100ms stereo RMS bins, active >= own-role preview peak RMS minus 30dB; coactivity measured relative to featured active bins. Correlation and activity are diagnostic, not proof of masking.
masking.full_song_section_method: Inherited tentative T001 section map; same STFT bands plus 100ms coactivity; report pairs only when overlap >.75, coactive union fraction >.25 and RMS difference <12dB. Activity floor -70dBFS. No full-song audio processed or exported.

limitations: Technical stability is verified; perceived localization, timbre naturalness, extreme proximity, externalization and comfort await human review.
Static gain compensation is estimated per role and home pose, not continuously remeasured along each angular trajectory.
Source labels inherited from provided stems, not verified identities; Other remains conservative.

gain_reference_correction.method: New/old sample-smoothed linked post-plugin control gain ratio; distance/pose/DSP unchanged
gain_reference_correction.earlier_T004_outputs: Preserved as superseded intermediate evidence, not listening recommendation
gain_reference_correction.event_growth_reference: Own spatial home, not 1.5m; monitors retain 1.5m starting reference
gain_reference_correction.quantization_limitation: Equivalent post-plugin gain change, within prior PCM24 half-LSB times gain ratio; no limiter or EQ
